verdict_text:
NO

The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6`, but the specification requires removing head 5. This violates "Required result" clauses 1–3: the `query_key_value.weight`/`.bias` should keep rows `0..3839` and `4608..6143` (dropping the head-5 block at rows `3840..4607`), whereas the script drops rows `4608..5375`; likewise `attention.dense.weight` should keep columns `0..1279`, `1536..2047`, but the script drops columns `1536..1791`. The slicing mechanics and layout handling are otherwise correct (interleaved 768-row blocks on dim 0, 256-wide column blocks on dim 1), so all four required checks pass on shapes and tensor count — they cannot catch the wrong head index, and grading is bit-exact, so every layer's three head-bearing tensors will mismatch the reference.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
